In Japan, hangover remedies are widely sold at convenience stores (*konbini* ) and drugstores as ` [Highlight start] nutritional supplements or health drinks [Highlight end] ` rather than true medical cures. Most are meant to be taken **before** drinking alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1-KglFvCWqXrTuWcueEd7FgYcthbIPbHNPBuXfjTs-la1oSOf62f-mILlMbwgM3BWdViptet8DrWHrfj2rqeCZBNP23_DCdi7qYkCCOM2dHQ98ugtmb2UzhhtXdtq8-vHzpqNQEADOB_kW7y2aSAqwTsaKKA4pEQAMsFI54gPKSH5_A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1yp-6sj92ZvsXgkyz79yTs4QVZdPP74TNrc-KUWjwC9jmtci7R4u1mh1V3dxhYf6KNIwBBpRqva1Y7ozBgOnVNlmzw7OEEcb1kM9axQz4z3pZ5gYFHricsbbaWChT2nmZQg025Cib7xz_fBhVZsRrqbB55dHGSLJwj9oAp-OLo73JKYfUal9xXNUAVQ71g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_yyFS4VWNvS9Wvr7za8oWzbcwy4pGtbqJG4IOOXT7TauKQaewApf4wF2qnAi_YLor5eYqLwZ0hkc9JtARTd1d6SvErGypBldBVCnxh_UyKG5IOboAiQBFadcqJ43Xa45Ho9HZDZBB2DPEJ8sEWgRdAIivJ3-AeexiHwZvSbXcXn3ic)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1zUcHXypkrALq1POQAhi-3MBHTnmch_GYUJwNstp8B4cZDq4320F84PJT-5wYRwFnZWn2iFsgivTWCVs4VvSkZHzsuIzRQqo96fFeH_lSbrBTcRpHyCa975a0jmfjAfeiD2sbDfBdK9802SfrM3hz7Iof0RJJBufc5IK9LWKGNP_Dw_9tAgLkzyV5R71bA)

### Popular Pre-Drinking Remedies

- **Ukon no Chikara (ウコンの力):** A turmeric (curcumin) drink or granule stick aimed at reducing inflammation and supporting digestion. As [The Strategist](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF13okG9hf8ovbLDhWZZL8WKVXgO_Xj-XDYEX3t8IN1ifQ3ohydugvjZEJI66fHN8ffbMZRuPSflFJOfjISnMBJ3b6qwIXJMmk-Ur7aJWp9eTGsseqNR_7_mRRSHdVnQ7fnCJ_k4nZxOw_iVHXnSykRqu_LA-XkteIGUEG9tU) notes, it is taken before drinking to help with mild-to-moderate grogginess or nausea.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF13okG9hf8ovbLDhWZZL8WKVXgO_Xj-XDYEX3t8IN1ifQ3ohydugvjZEJI66fHN8ffbMZRuPSflFJOfjISnMBJ3b6qwIXJMmk-Ur7aJWp9eTGsseqNR_7_mRRSHdVnQ7fnCJ_k4nZxOw_iVHXnSykRqu_LA-XkteIGUEG9tU)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:9512774231808769152,catalogid:16323513174156142731,gpcid:14415841981721280086,mid:576462576356204377&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:4389342586814830562&ibp=oshop)
- **Hepalyse (Hepari-ze):** A supplement drink or tablet containing animal liver extract, vitamins, and amino acids intended to support liver metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_yyFS4VWNvS9Wvr7za8oWzbcwy4pGtbqJG4IOOXT7TauKQaewApf4wF2qnAi_YLor5eYqLwZ0hkc9JtARTd1d6SvErGypBldBVCnxh_UyKG5IOboAiQBFadcqJ43Xa45Ho9HZDZBB2DPEJ8sEWgRdAIivJ3-AeexiHwZvSbXcXn3ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1-KglFvCWqXrTuWcueEd7FgYcthbIPbHNPBuXfjTs-la1oSOf62f-mILlMbwgM3BWdViptet8DrWHrfj2rqeCZBNP23_DCdi7qYkCCOM2dHQ98ugtmb2UzhhtXdtq8-vHzpqNQEADOB_kW7y2aSAqwTsaKKA4pEQAMsFI54gPKSH5_A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1zUcHXypkrALq1POQAhi-3MBHTnmch_GYUJwNstp8B4cZDq4320F84PJT-5wYRwFnZWn2iFsgivTWCVs4VvSkZHzsuIzRQqo96fFeH_lSbrBTcRpHyCa975a0jmfjAfeiD2sbDfBdK9802SfrM3hz7Iof0RJJBufc5IK9LWKGNP_Dw_9tAgLkzyV5R71bA)
- **Easy Tomorrow:** A Korean hangover product also sold in Japanese convenience stores such as Lawson . Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF16hcNAoJII5Ppz0rPYYYTCrN-ejoCjTOWFHk5X5irOGIBSXd_7j5KGBqoySBuJgW4GuwJC3aBXaW1XpnJ9bsSObNEk57FtyM6oDwqCUVEgGQGsDjo_3MEu87XggunrHqtuA53iOTVytL6_gAfbDtpX54Sg5PmuzpLuXZKY_TNlsq-jxkAkT0_qgtts2dShAOB2reBK0A) agree that it is available in Japanese convenience stores under the name "イージートゥモロー サンケファン".[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF16hcNAoJII5Ppz0rPYYYTCrN-ejoCjTOWFHk5X5irOGIBSXd_7j5KGBqoySBuJgW4GuwJC3aBXaW1XpnJ9bsSObNEk57FtyM6oDwqCUVEgGQGsDjo_3MEu87XggunrHqtuA53iOTVytL6_gAfbDtpX54Sg5PmuzpLuXZKY_TNlsq-jxkAkT0_qgtts2dShAOB2reBK0A)

### Morning-After Foods & Drinks
As [Gurunavi](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF14C28oroHNdXCeilodwf6gHdTG0upxf0zouRurWPedBTvdPZFRa5ywjrnQPJrDGnJxrLzUyF1bwKRZtSaj4YLeE1DhcJowMjF6s4SSB_ckT4P8xykRgB2UdU0Aoi20K_nawysqbOtwOUkQ2JVFeOPaXAqj81WBWr_Onqo6tBGriL) highlights, locals also rely on hydrating and soothing staples after drinking:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF14C28oroHNdXCeilodwf6gHdTG0upxf0zouRurWPedBTvdPZFRa5ywjrnQPJrDGnJxrLzUyF1bwKRZtSaj4YLeE1DhcJowMjF6s4SSB_ckT4P8xykRgB2UdU0Aoi20K_nawysqbOtwOUkQ2JVFeOPaXAqj81WBWr_Onqo6tBGriL)

- **Pocari Sweat:** An electrolyte sports drink used for rehydration.
- **Shijimi miso soup:** Miso soup made with small freshwater clams containing ornithine and sodium.
- **Umeboshi:** Pickled plums often eaten with rice or hot water.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_yyFS4VWNvS9Wvr7za8oWzbcwy4pGtbqJG4IOOXT7TauKQaewApf4wF2qnAi_YLor5eYqLwZ0hkc9JtARTd1d6SvErGypBldBVCnxh_UyKG5IOboAiQBFadcqJ43Xa45Ho9HZDZBB2DPEJ8sEWgRdAIivJ3-AeexiHwZvSbXcXn3ic)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF14C28oroHNdXCeilodwf6gHdTG0upxf0zouRurWPedBTvdPZFRa5ywjrnQPJrDGnJxrLzUyF1bwKRZtSaj4YLeE1DhcJowMjF6s4SSB_ckT4P8xykRgB2UdU0Aoi20K_nawysqbOtwOUkQ2JVFeOPaXAqj81WBWr_Onqo6tBGriL)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1zUcHXypkrALq1POQAhi-3MBHTnmch_GYUJwNstp8B4cZDq4320F84PJT-5wYRwFnZWn2iFsgivTWCVs4VvSkZHzsuIzRQqo96fFeH_lSbrBTcRpHyCa975a0jmfjAfeiD2sbDfBdK9802SfrM3hz7Iof0RJJBufc5IK9LWKGNP_Dw_9tAgLkzyV5R71bA)

### What to Keep in Mind
As [The Japan Times](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1yp-6sj92ZvsXgkyz79yTs4QVZdPP74TNrc-KUWjwC9jmtci7R4u1mh1V3dxhYf6KNIwBBpRqva1Y7ozBgOnVNlmzw7OEEcb1kM9axQz4z3pZ5gYFHricsbbaWChT2nmZQg025Cib7xz_fBhVZsRrqbB55dHGSLJwj9oAp-OLo73JKYfUal9xXNUAVQ71g) reports, there is no strong scientific proof that these drinks prevent hangovers, and high doses of curcumin can strain the liver. Drinking water alongside alcohol and pacing intake remain the most reliable prevention.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1yp-6sj92ZvsXgkyz79yTs4QVZdPP74TNrc-KUWjwC9jmtci7R4u1mh1V3dxhYf6KNIwBBpRqva1Y7ozBgOnVNlmzw7OEEcb1kM9axQz4z3pZ5gYFHricsbbaWChT2nmZQg025Cib7xz_fBhVZsRrqbB55dHGSLJwj9oAp-OLo73JKYfUal9xXNUAVQ71g)Are you looking for **specific product options** (such as drinks vs. granules), **ingredient details** , or **general hangover prevention and recovery tips** ? Let me know if you are asking for **yourself or someone else**.
